object: Frozen final14/F16384 binary feature events; fixed full-cache communities and bounded sample regenerated communities.
question: Does co-occurrence organization exceed size/mean-frequency matching and a fixed-margin full-pipeline null, and which partition stability is actually supported?
repair_observation: Fixed 10000-proposal cap missed large-group retention; single-slot sampler for small fixed-sum groups also drifted slowly in frequency separation despite member replacement.
repair_interpretation: These explain the failed control estimator, not a scientific feature mechanism. Exact iid conditional pair/triple draws and larger fixed-schedule MCMC repair estimation under the same conditional target.
counterargument1: Could the advantage be only many tiny groups? Group-weighted effect is -0.25147 dex but member-weighted remains -0.15500; large-group effect remains -0.14751 memberweighted. Tiny groups amplify but do not wholly create observed mean-matched frequency concentration.
counterargument2: Does the matched result remove graph selection bias? No. Matching controls D mean and group size but not phi bounds, mutual-top-q, or community selection. Only the bounded full-pipeline fixed-margin null addresses those jointly; it cannot calibrate full-cache graph significance.
counterargument3: Does an average Jaccard 0.548 identify robust expert boundaries? Member-weighted Jaccard is 0.32190 and q10-to-q20 within-group pair retention 0.38265. Specific big-group boundaries remain sensitive.
counterargument4: Can zero V hits be silently smoothed and called original H1? No. Original strict sample Tb remains NA. Jeffreys-smoothed sample score is a separately registered post-observation exploration; all original groups/nulls remain, no endpoint-based dropping or V-based resampling.
claim_boundary: Even successful approximate bounded calibration would establish residual organization in these exposed within-bin event samples, not independent-document replication, semantic hierarchy, causal mechanism, learning utility or model capacity.
mixing_boundary: Detailed balance and exact margins do not prove global MCMC mixing. Diagnostic gates are necessary finite checks; all raw qualification data and failed attempts are retained.
scientific_state: Pending full-pipeline bounded calibration; original strict full matched endpoint now estimable; no human scientific state transition.
new_sampler_diagnosis: Some null size3 groups had only hundreds of valid triples among ~5e10 possibilities. Uniform rejection was exact when completed but had negligible feasible probability. Replacing it uniformly for all sample observed/qualification/null size3 groups by exact integer-indexed counting repairs numerical coverage under the same target law; old NA results remain. This is not a feature mechanism discovery.
remaining_rivals: Text composition, encoder/gate geometry and feature redundancy can produce coactivation beyond global row/column margins; current null does not identify semantic or functional source.
zero_support_witness: Feature10045: bounded sample D30/V0 but full-window D19655/V12743; empirical zero and original strict endpoint NA do not imply true zero frequency.
authority: Execution-side factual and inferential audit; no Focus/Anchor/Protocol scientific state transition.
